note: Newest first. One entry per change to a skill or scheduled task. Written by whoever ships the change (Analyst for strategy, Architect for plumbing). Keep each field to one sentence.

changes.title: Opponent line back on picks
changes.change: The opponent allowance (e.g. 'Opp 112.54 (9–/25)', with its up/down arrow) shows again under each pick and lean; it was left out when the cards became tables on 10 Nov. It's hidden when the slate sends no value.
changes.aim: Restore the matchup context Mitch uses when reading a pick.

changes.title: Leans collapsed under each game
changes.change: Each game's leans now sit in a collapsed row under its picks, titled 'Leans (n) · near-misses, tracked not bet'; opening it explains they just missed a pick rule (cushion, price cap or looser test) and are staked at 0u.
changes.aim: Keep the real picks front and centre while leaving the near-misses one tap away.

changes.title: No limits on picks per game or per player
changes.change: The 3-picks-per-game, 2-per-player and 3u-per-game caps are removed, so every pick that clears the gates is bet at its full stake; a game with 4+ picks is flagged STACK for information only.
changes.aim: With the cushion gate and 1.85 cap the slate makes about 1–3 picks a day and the caps weren't binding; Mitch wants every qualifying pick, accepting that picks in one game can lose together.

changes.title: Injuries, back-to-backs and coverage sent to the dashboard
changes.change: Every analysed game now also carries out / q (each team's Out and Questionable/Doubtful players from the official injury report), b2b (teams on a back-to-back) and cov (the coverage counts and skipped players) for the dashboard; picks are unchanged.
changes.aim: Architect request §9 item 14: show each game's injury and schedule context on the dashboard without any Sheet or script change.

changes.title: Game cards as mini tables, with who's out
changes.change: Each game card now has two small tables: game info (Out, Doubtful / Q and B2B per team, the total with prices, coverage) and the picks with their leans (shaded, 0u) in one table with odds, hit, edge and stake. Until the slate sends structured injury fields, the info table shows the slate's note text instead.
changes.aim: Bring back a clear view of who's out and make each game readable at a glance.

changes.title: Safer-rung display retired
changes.change: The slate no longer computes or shows a 'safer rung' on 1.80+ picks (it never actually populated, and the 1.85 cap left it covering only 1.80–1.85 picks); the slate now also checks that every 2-star pick is staked at 0.25u.
changes.aim: Remove a step that silently never ran; stepping down a rung can now be analysed after the fact from the alt-ladder log.

changes.title: Alt-ladder log: every Pointsbet rung recorded
changes.change: Each slate run now saves its alt-odds fetch and logs every Pointsbet alt rung (line:price, Over and Under) for every player and stat of the games it analysed into the Sheet's new `ladders` tab, one row per ladder. No extra Odds API requests.
changes.aim: Give the Fable price-map and rung-policy study real prices for every rung (about 14 slates for a coarse calibration, 30 for the map).

changes.title: Model totals settle the same night
changes.change: The resolve now settles a game's total the same evening it is recorded, if the score feed already has it final. Before, each day's totals settled the following evening.
changes.aim: Totals results land the same night as the props.

changes.title: Leans 6–8 Nov backfilled; leans failures now alert
changes.change: The leans tab was never published, so the resolve could not read it and skipped leans every night. 14 leans from 6–8 Nov were recovered from data.json history and settled from box scores. A leans failure now sends a push notification instead of one quiet output line.
changes.aim: Make the lean test possible and stop a silent gap recurring.

changes.title: 2-star picks staked at 0.25u
changes.change: The skill said 0.5u for 2-star picks in one rule and 0.25u in another; it now says 0.25u everywhere, and the Monday review splits gated picks into perfect vs one-miss samples to test 'perfect samples only' as the next rule.
changes.aim: Remove the stake ambiguity on the lowest-confidence picks and line up the next test (perfect samples 73% +4.9u vs one-miss 52% −30u for the season).

changes.title: No staked picks priced above 1.85
changes.change: A rung can only be a staked pick if its price is 1.85 or shorter; rungs that pass everything else at a longer price become CAP leans (0u), so the killed picks are still tracked.
changes.aim: Picks at 1.86+ went 4/22 (18% vs 51% implied, −14.3u) because the engine's assumed bookmaker margin is about half the real one at long prices; judge on CAP lean results and staked ROI over the next 50 picks.

changes.title: Z-margin and teammate-out flags on every pick (shadow, under test)
changes.change: Every pick and lean now carries Z<z> (how many standard deviations the line sits below the player's average) and TMO / TMO-Q / RET when a top-3 scoring teammate is out, questionable or just returning; they never change a pick, and the Monday review tests them at n≥30.
changes.aim: Fable's 2,607-game study found hit rate climbs from 58% at z<0.5 to 89% at z≥1.5 and teammates gain 6pp when a top scorer sits; test whether that beats the price on our own bets before any rule.

changes.title: Picks need a cushion: alt at most 70% of the player's average
changes.change: A rung can only be a staked pick if its alt line is at most 0.70 × the player's average over the same sample games; rungs that pass everything else but not this become CUSH leans (0u), and every pick and lean carries a C<ratio> flag (e.g. C0.62).
changes.aim: Picks with that cushion went 29/36 (81% vs 67% implied, +7.3u) and the rest 95/182 (52%, −31u); judge on the first 50 gated picks by hit vs implied and CLV.

changes.title: Each game shows how many players were checked
changes.change: Every analysed game now carries a Coverage line (in the run output and the game context on the dashboard) counting the players and player-stats with a Pointsbet alt ladder that were evaluated, and naming any skipped with the reason; picks are unchanged.
changes.aim: Make it visible that every player is reviewed and nothing is silently skipped, e.g. a name that fails to match ESPN.

changes.title: Overtime games no longer inflate a player's sample
changes.change: When a game in a player's sample went to overtime, its minutes, points, rebounds and assists are scaled back to 48 minutes (one OT ×0.906) before hits are counted, and the pick or lean is flagged OT-ADJ; bets still settle on the real box score including overtime.
changes.aim: Stop overtime-assisted hits making a 4/5 player look 5/5 at the edge of the +3pp bar (Zion's 7/8 on 7 Nov contained three overtime games and was really 6/8).

changes.title: Player game logs now come from ESPN, with a freshness check
changes.change: Hit rates are now counted from ESPN game logs (full current season, newest 10 games, minutes included) instead of StatMuse, any player who sat his team's last game is flagged DNP-LAST, and the slate re-counts every sample before saving; StatMuse is a flagged fallback only. Today's (7 Nov) picks were deleted and rebuilt on the new logs.
changes.aim: StatMuse was returning short, stale samples (Maxey shown 5/5 when he was 8/9, Derrick White 4/4 when he was 6/8 and below the edge bar), so picks were being made on the wrong games.

changes.title: Minutes-trend flag on picks and leans (shadow, under test)
changes.change: Every pick and lean whose player has 7+ games this season now carries MT+ when his last-5 minutes are 1.5+ above his last 10, or MT- when 1.5+ below; it never changes a pick, and the Monday review compares flagged against unflagged results.
changes.aim: Test on our own bets whether a rising or falling minutes role predicts results beyond the price (two seasons of box scores showed a 6–7pp hit-rate gap), before ever making it a rule.

changes.title: More leans on quiet days, flagged QUIET
changes.change: On a Melbourne date with fewer than 4 NBA games, leans use m = 15 instead of 20 (so 4/5 and 5/6 samples can show) and every lean that day carries a QUIET flag; staked picks stay at m = 30 every day.
changes.aim: Give quiet days some tracked 0u data without lowering the staked bar, and keep QUIET leans separable so they can be judged on their own.

changes.title: Leans tracked separately (0u)
changes.change: From the 6 Nov slate (nba-session v3.9) each game can carry leans: rungs that pass at m=20 but not m=30. The 18:07 resolve records them from data.json into the Sheet's new `leans` tab and settles them from the same box scores. A collapsed 'Leans (0u)' section shows hit rate against market-implied, record and notional 1u units for 7d / 30d / season. Leans are never staked and never touch the cohort, stats, record, units or hit rate.
changes.aim: Judge whether m=20 rungs earn their keep once n≥30, without them muddying the real record.

changes.title: Stricter picks again, plus a tracked 0u lean tier
changes.change: The shrink weight goes back from 15 to 30, so staked picks again need a near-perfect sample (e.g. 5/5 or 6/6 at 1.40–1.50), and rungs that pass only at m = 20 are shown as LEAN at 0u in a separate leans list that is never staked, recorded in the cohort or sent to Telegram.
changes.aim: v3.8 went 33/57 (57.9%) against ~66% implied, −6.63u, almost all from one-miss samples (17/36); this restores quality while still measuring whether those quieter samples carry any signal.

changes.title: Today's slate first; today's games listed from the first run
changes.change: Today's slate moved to the top. Copy buttons removed. Projected totals and model totals collapsed. From the first slate run (02:07) the slate lists today's games from the schedule, each marked with when its picks are due; the previous day's games are cleared. A day with no games shows 'No NBA games today'.
changes.aim: See what's on today at a glance, without yesterday's games hanging around.

changes.title: Resolve moved to 18:07 so late games settle the same night
changes.change: The nightly resolve now runs at 18:07 instead of 17:07, because a game is only settled 3h15 after tip and 14:10–14:40 tips were missing the 17:07 run and waiting a full day.
changes.aim: Every game's results, Telegram summary and record update land the same evening.

changes.title: Evening results posted to the Telegram group
changes.change: Each 17:07 resolve posts one Telegram message to the group with every settled pick (✅/❌, line, odds, actual), the day's W-L and units, the 7d/30d/season record and tomorrow's first tip; failures still go to Claude push privately.
changes.aim: See results and the next-day heads-up in the same place as the picks.

changes.title: Pick alerts now go to Telegram
changes.change: Each slate run that makes picks sends one Telegram message to @NBAboomybot with every game, tip and pick (line, odds, hit rate, stars, stake, safer rung), built by a hash-pinned script; Claude push is now only the fallback if Telegram fails.
changes.aim: Get the full pick list on the phone the moment it's made, without opening the dashboard.

changes.title: Model totals tracked as notional 1u bets
changes.change: Every analysed game's projected and market total (with Pointsbet over/under prices from 2 Nov) is recorded in a separate `totals` tab, settled from free final scores including overtime, and shown in a collapsed Model totals section with record, units, ROI and hit rate by window, gap bucket and side; the 22 Oct–1 Nov Notion log is shown separately at an assumed 1.91.
changes.aim: See whether the projected-total lean beats the market, kept apart from the prop record.

changes.title: Market total prices kept for the totals tracker
changes.change: Each analysed game now also records the Pointsbet Over and Under prices at the market total (mkt_o, mkt_u) from the totals call the slate already makes, at no extra Odds API cost; picks and the totals row are unchanged.
changes.aim: Score every model totals lean as a notional 1u bet at the real price, so the separate totals tracker shows what the model would have done.

changes.title: Next slate line on the dashboard
changes.change: Today's slate now shows the next game day's first tip, game count, last tip and first slate run, from a schedule.json the 17:07 resolve refreshes each evening via the free events call; the status banner now follows the 02:07 start.
changes.aim: Know at a glance when tomorrow's picks will start arriving without waiting for the evening notification.

changes.title: Every game included, whatever the tip time
changes.change: The early-morning cut-off is removed: the slate now runs hourly from 02:07 and capture from 03:48, so games tipping as early as about 04:00 Melbourne time get picks and a closing price, and the evening heads-up counts every game.
changes.aim: Stop skipping early weekend and holiday tips now that Mitch wants all games covered.

changes.title: Evening heads-up for tomorrow's games
changes.change: Every 17:07 run now sends one notification that ends with tomorrow's first tip, game count, last tip and the time of the first slate run, even when nothing needed settling.
changes.aim: Let Mitch know each evening when the first picks will arrive.

changes.title: Five-game samples can now qualify
changes.change: The shrink weight drops from 30 to 15 pseudo-games, so a player's 5 current-season games count for 25% of the estimate instead of 14% and a 4/5 or 5/5 record can pass the +3pp test.
changes.aim: Stop early-season slates going blank (2 Nov had none) while keeping the price as the main anchor; the review watches whether predicted hit rate drifts above actual.

changes.title: Player logs now come from the right season
changes.change: StatMuse names seasons by the year they end, so current-season logs now use 2027 and a 2026 table is treated as last season.
changes.aim: Make sure picks are judged on this season's games, not last season's.

changes.title: Slate and capture start two hours earlier
changes.change: The slate now runs hourly from 06:07 (was 08:07) and analyses games tipping from 06:37, and capture runs from 06:48 (was 08:48), still at minute :48.
changes.aim: Cover early tips such as 07:40 games, which the 08:07 start skipped.

changes.title: Each game analysed once, 30–150 minutes before its own tip
changes.change: The slate now runs hourly from 08:07 to 13:07 and analyses only games that tip within 150 minutes, at least 30 minutes away and not yet done today, with one totals call per run that has games, and capture now runs hourly at :48 from 08:48 to 14:48.
changes.aim: Catch early tips and fresher injury news game by game, while skipping games before 08:37 when Mitch can't bet them.

changes.title: Ready for hourly per-game slate runs
changes.change: Each slate run now merges its games into the day's dashboard file instead of replacing it, reports which games are already done today, and capture prices each pick once in its last 2–70 minutes before tip.
changes.aim: Let picks be made closer to tip, game by game, without losing earlier games or pricing the close twice.

changes.title: Every game on the slate is analysed
changes.change: The 4-game limit is removed, so the slate prices every game and cuts games only when the Odds API quota can't cover them plus a 50-request reserve for closing-odds capture.
changes.aim: Stop missing qualifying picks on big nights now that the stricter v3.5 test filters for quality instead of a game limit.

changes.title: Max 3 picks per game, no session cap
changes.change: Each game now allows at most 3 picks (was 5), the 8u session cap is removed because the per-game caps already limit a session to 12 picks, and any pick a cap trims is dropped instead of being logged.
changes.aim: Cut stacked exposure to one game's pace and blowout risk, and keep the record to picks the engine actually stands behind.

changes.title: Hit rates recalibrated toward the market price
changes.change: Each rung's probability now leans 75% on a price-adjusted market estimate (bookmaker margin assumed to rise from 0% at 1.50 to about 22% at 1.95), and a pick needs at least +3pp over the break-even price instead of +5pp over a margin-free price.
changes.aim: Close the gap between the 81% hit rate the model claimed and the 56% it delivered, which should mean fewer, shorter-priced picks and 1.80+ only on near-perfect samples.

changes.title: Picks, closes and results now recorded straight to the Google Sheet
changes.change: All three tasks write the Sheet through one hash-pinned script and check the Sheet's own totals after every write; Notion and record.json are no longer written.
changes.aim: One reliable record that the dashboard and the weekly analyst review read directly, with no copying between systems.

changes.title: Safer rung on 1.80+ picks
changes.change: Every pick priced 1.80 or longer now shows the next rung down priced 1.40–1.79, with its own hit rate; display only, not logged as a pick.
changes.aim: Make a higher-hit-rate alternative visible on long prices, and track whether stepping down would have paid.

changes.title: Resolve no longer overwrites closing prices
changes.change: Close odds and CLV are now owned by the capture task; resolve only marks a still-blank close as 'no close', and runs on Melbourne time.
changes.aim: Protect the closing-line data needed to judge whether picks beat the market.

changes.title: Closing-odds capture fixed
changes.change: A parsing bug had blanked every odds response, so 91% of picks had no closing price; capture now runs hourly before tip and asks only for markets with picks.
changes.aim: Get closing-line value (CLV) on every pick — the fastest honest signal of whether the model has an edge.
